items.title: Set up the readiness program: profile, data tiers, schedule
items.done_when: profile.json saved, data readiness map produced, recurring jobs scheduled and the first weekly brief delivered
items.protects_against: Running the year on memory instead of a system

history.note: Profile, data tiers and schedule set up; first brief delivered

items.title: Run a 2027 downside case by payer
items.done_when: Base, downside and severe scenarios reviewed by the CFO, with cash runway and the trigger points that move the organization from base to downside

history.note: Base and downside run; severe case review with CFO on Dec 4

items.title: List every commercial contract renewing in 2027 with escalator and notice dates
items.done_when: Every commercial contract has a notice deadline, an escalator and a negotiation-prep start date on the schedule
items.protects_against: Flat or negative renewals and missed notice windows

history.note: Two contracts have no confirmed notice date; payer reps contacted

items.title: Re-verify eligibility at every visit and flag expansion adults due for six-month renewal
items.done_when: Eligibility runs before every visit, expansion adults are flagged, and a weekly coverage-churn worklist exists
items.protects_against: Retroactive eligibility denials and surprise self-pay

history.note: Batch 270/271 at 72 hours live at 6 of 9 sites

items.title: Give price estimates, collect at time of service, offer payment plans
items.done_when: Estimate, collection and payment-plan scripts are live, the financial assistance policy is updated, and the POS collection rate is tracked weekly

items.title: Help Medicaid patients document work hours and exemptions
items.owner_role: Patient access or care management lead
items.done_when: At-risk patients receive outreach, exemption screening is part of intake, and diagnosis documentation supports frailty exemptions where accurate

items.title: Audit AI-assisted coding before payers do
items.done_when: E/M distribution by provider compared to baseline and benchmark, probe sample reviewed, findings and corrective actions documented

items.title: Move eligible imaging, infusion and procedures to office or ASC settings
items.done_when: Each candidate service has a margin comparison by site and a go or no-go decision with an owner

items.title: Inventory vendors holding PHI and test downtime and claims backup
items.done_when: Cash-critical vendors identified, BAAs confirmed, a backup clearinghouse path exists and a downtime tabletop has been run
items.protects_against: A vendor breach that stops cash
items.decision_needed: Approve a secondary clearinghouse contract (about 6 weeks to stand up)

history.note: Vendor list waiting on IT asset export

items.done_when: Every live deal has a state-by-state notice map, a dated filing plan and a governance checklist reviewed by counsel
